machine: Windows 11, Intel i7-14700KF, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti, Chrome 155 (desktop), window 1084x815 CSS px, devicePixelRatio 1
method: Production build served by backend (uvicorn) on localhost:8300. In-app Engine.benchmark(seconds): records requestAnimationFrame intervals and the JS time spent inside each frame (cpuFrameMs; excludes GPU execution). Scenario: Launch, wait until T+3 s (pad camera, peak smoke/plume/particle emission at lift-off), then sample 6-8 s. Frame rate is capped by display vsync (~131 Hz on this monitor), so 'fps at cap' means GPU/CPU headroom remains. GPU memory is an estimate (particle buffers + render targets), not a driver measurement. JS heap = performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize.

runs.name: WebGPU default (auto tier=high, 48k compute particles, MSAA 4, shadows 4096)
WebGL2 backend, auto tier=medium (16k analytic particles)
WebGL2 backend, high + pixelRatio 2 (48k analytic particles, 2168x1630)
Phone-equivalent settings on desktop (tier=low, 6k particles, no MSAA)

not_measured: No physical phone was available; phone performance is untested. Motion blur (?mblur=1) was not benchmarked (disabled by default because the velocity MRT smeared transparent sprites).
